notes.title: Zombies vs Vampires Fest 2.2 Patch | Harrowed World: What's Past Is Portents
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973968/bb47c8d95a0970eb48498bf9997fd64893cddf9a.png[/img]
‘Harrowed World: What’s Past Is Portents’ has been updated to Patch 2.2 just in time for Steam’s Zombies vs Vampires Fest that begins tomorrow on Dracula Day!

This game will be featuring in the Fest as a current free release and ‘Harrowed World: Portents In Red’ will be featuring as a future release.

Fixes, additions and improvements:
🩸 Improved descriptions of words in Lexicon.
🩸 Improved explanation of Chronicle.
🩸 Fixed incorrect images showing for the State of Grace achievement in game.
🩸 Created new Legends of the Legacies submenus under a new Extras menu with unlockable extras that will be a part of the DLC.
🩸 Put Chronicle under Extras.
🩸 Skip now locked during first playthrough, so players have a chance to probably appreciate the story.
🩸 Made some minor UI improvements and changes, mostly in preparation for the DLC. 

Notes:
💀 If you are playing on Steam and there’s any issues with unlocked achievements not showing correctly in game then start a new playthrough of Issac’s Story and the achievements should resync with Steam automatically. 
💀 ‘Legends of the Legacies’ was previously referred to as ‘Legacy Introductions’ and ‘Legacy Reveals’ before a final name was chosen.

notes.title: A New Voice in the Darkness – Unveiling the Narrator Update
notes.content:
‘Harrowed World: What’s Past Is Portents’ enters version 2.0 with the Narrator Update.

[previewyoutube=cje411RHx2k;full][/previewyoutube]

Additions and improvements:
🩸 New voice acting.
🩸 ​All new epilogue.
🩸 New internal achievements system.
🩸 New lexicon system.
🩸 New game over screens.
🩸 Higher quality icon.
🩸 New and improved story selection screen.
🩸 Revamped main menu.
🩸 New pause menu and revamped submenus.
🩸 Added story name to save files (will be useful once future stories are added).
🩸 Revamped credits.
🩸 Added scene transitions.
🩸 Various other fixes and additions.

Notes:
💀 You may need to uninstall and reinstall to see the new icon.
💀 Internal achievements for Isaac's Story syncs with Steam at the start of a new playthrough.
💀 Lexicon system will require new playthrough(s) to unlock terminology.
💀 Story name will only appear on new saves.
💀 Lexicon was originally referred to as glossary during it's development.
💀 Options is now called Settings.
💀 History is now called Chronicle.
💀 Controls are now under Settings.

notes.title: Pre-Launch Fixes and Additions
notes.content:
Minor fixes and additions to the game before the 11th June launch. 

With thanks to the content creators on the Creator Program that brought these issues to my attention.  

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixes to minor mistakes in narration and character dialogue.
[*] Removed second mention of Isaac’s parents not listening to him as it's redundant. 
[*] Fixed overlapping character animation.
[/list]

In response to certain observations made in Content Creator streams and videos I have made a few additions to make playing easier: 
[list]
[*] Tips screen added at the start informing you about the achievements and the likelihood of you needing to play more than once to achieve them all, as well as informing you of the assistive self-voicing feature. 
[*] Added a (surprisingly complex) back option to the game over screen. 
[*] Added the option to play again after the credits with two jump back points. 
[*] Got distracted making a whole new Story Selection menu because that's the kind of person I am.
[/list]

Known Issues: 
[list]
[*] For those streaming the game, playing in full screen can cause the game to lag for viewers. The reason for this is unknown and until a fix can be found it’s advisable to play the game in windowed mode.
[/list]

I hope you all enjoy the game and please leave review; each one is a big help.

– Alex Burton
Owner of Pennyvale Media.
Creator of Harrowed World.
Writer, Programmer, and Executive Producer of 'Harrowed World: What’s Past Is Portents'.
